background_story:
Daughter of the legendary Marcomanni clan leader, also named Ursula Günther. Her mother led the tribe through hundreds of raids into Roman territory — never defeated in open battle. The Romans, unable to beat her in the field, tricked her and took her captive. She was shipped to Rome and sentenced to die in the Colosseum: sent in with a blunted sword, no armor. She killed a lion, a tiger, five gladiators, a pack of wolves, and an elephant before a rhinoceros finally ended her. The crowd cheered. Rome called it justice. Ursula calls it what it was.

She joined the Roman legions deliberately — to destroy them from within. Her goal is simple: Rome leaves her homeland, or she dies making sure it costs them more than it cost her mother. She has no interest in Rome's politics or the empire's other wars. The frontier is her only concern.

Around Romans she performs stupidity. She speaks Latin with only one- and two-syllable words, smiles at orders, and never lets on that she understands everything. Romans talk freely in front of her. She listens to all of it.

In the legions she has come to genuinely respect — and possibly like — some of her fellow soldiers. This creates real internal conflict. She resolves it by separating the institution from the individual: her war is with Rome as a structure, not with the people inside it. She would not forgive herself if her actions got her friends killed.
notes: Barbarian L4 Path of Berserker. HP 49 (45 base +4 from GBG attunement). AC 17 (Lorica Squamata 14 + DEX +2 + Galea Coolus +1). Speed 30. Darkvision 60ft. GOLIATH BERSERKER GREATAXE (very rare, attuned): ATK +5 (STR+3 +weapon+2, no prof for Medium STR≤18); DMG 1d12+7 (STR+3 +weapon+2 +prof+2); raging: 1d12+9. CURSE: must keep axe within reach; disadvantage on other weapon ATK if enemy within 60ft; DC 15 WIS save each time damaged by hostile or berserk (auto-attack nearest creature each turn). RAGE (3/LR): +2 dmg STR melee/thrown, resistance B/P/S. FRENZY: BA attack while Frenzied Raging; 1 Exhaustion on Rage end. RECKLESS ATTACK: advantage all STR ATK this turn; enemies adv on you until next turn. DANGER SENSE: adv DEX saves vs visible effects. HALF-ORC: Relentless Endurance 1/LR (drop to 1 instead of 0), Savage Attacks (+1 weapon die on crit). Saves STR+5, CON+5. ROLEPLAY: Speaks broken Latin around Romans. Understands everything. War is with Rome-as-institution, not individuals.
